statement: All 76 matrix/thread configurations passed host device-source emulation and independent full/low row-space replay.
scope: 19 matrices, four emulated thread counts, declared eager/lazy branches; CPU execution.
assumptions: Frozen shared C source and exported input/output matrices.
not_implied: A GPU was run in that iteration.
Complete F4 queries agree or GPU performance improves.
lesson: Host emulation is a reusable correctness gate, not evidence against GPU acceleration.
next_discriminating_test: Replay the frozen matrices on a real GPU, then compare complete queries including transfers and reconstruction.
revisit_when: Replay the frozen matrices on a real GPU, then compare complete queries including transfers and reconstruction.
